title: The Rails Way And Consulting Practice: Mike Hall Interviews Obie Fernandez | RailsConf 2014

dimensions.historical_context_at_recording: RailsConf 2014 Chicago (Rails 4.1), GOTO Chicago 2014, Continuous Delivery boom with Jez Humble, Brakeman security adoption.
dimensions.subsequent_history_and_trajectory: Rails 5/6/7 evolved into full-stack monoliths with Hotwire; Hashrocket expanded and Obie authored subsequent books on Lean publishing.
